chunks: Musa ibn Umar ibn Buzay' asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha عليه السلام and said to him:
"I tie the waist wrap and the scarf over my shirt during salat (prayer)." He said: "There is no harm."

key_terms.الْإِزَارَ: a waist wrap or lower garment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wear a waist wrap and a scarf over one's shirt during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states that wearing a waist wrap and a scarf over one's shirt during salat (prayer) is permissible. Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام gives a brief legal ruling indicating that such dress in prayer carries no objection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.784 - Musa ibn Umar ibn Buzai' asked Abu Al-Hasan, Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as):

"I tie a waist wrap and a scarf over my shirt during prayer."
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm”.
